title: Congratulations

you-held-it-all.title: You held it all
you-held-it-all.script: Congratulations, you made it to the end. Now you know how it feels to be an AI. You took in everything I said: the start stayed sharp, the end stayed sharp, and somewhere in the middle it got a little blurry. That is all the window ever is, so now go and manage yours. One more time? Or again in a minute?

punchline: Now you know how it feels. One more time? Or again in a minute?
